title: Suite Magnolia I Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Charming 2BR Seaside home just a 5 minute walk to the beach and steps from shops, dining, and the West Side Pool. Park once and enjoy effortless Seaside living. Perfect for young families!
description_expanded: Description640 FOREST STREET2 Queens, Sleeps 4 Suite Magnolia I – 5-Minute Walk to BeachSuite Magnolia I is a charming two-bedroom vacation rental in the heart of Seaside, Florida,designed for couples and young families seeking a relaxed, walkable 30A beach getaway.Ideally located just a five-minute walk to Seaside’s private beach access and only four minutesfrom the West End Family Pool, this thoughtfully positioned cottage allows guests to park onceand enjoy everything Seaside has to offer on foot. With more than 40 restaurants, boutiques,cafés, and local shops just steps away, spontaneous dining and sunset strolls are part of theexperience.Outdoor Living & Convenient ArrivalUpon arrival, guests are welcomed by a ground-level open-air porch complete with a classicbench swing—perfect for morning coffee or unwinding after a day along the Gulf. An adjacentcharcoal grill provides an easy setup for casual beachside cookouts. The property includesdesignated parking for one vehicle directly in front of the cottage, and as the front residence onthe lot, Suite Magnolia 1 offers added convenience when unloading luggage and beach gear.Two Private Queen Suites on the First FloorThe first floor is dedicated to restful accommodations, featuring two queen bedrooms, each withits own private ensuite bathroom—an ideal layout for two couples or families traveling together.One bedroom offers abundant natural light, a spacious dresser, and an updated ensuite with asingle vanity and a tub/shower combination. The second queen bedroom includes a centraldresser, private television, and an updated ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and aglass-enclosed walk-in shower. A central staircase leads upstairs to the main living space.Bright Second-Floor Living with Screened PorchThe second level opens to a light-filled living area with vaulted ceilings and coastal charmthroughout. Two green sofas and a club chair are arranged around a central coffee table,creating a comfortable space for relaxing or enjoying movie nights on the mounted flat-screenTV.French doors extend the living space onto a spacious screened-in porch featuring outdoordining for four and two rocking chairs. Whether enjoying al fresco meals, coastal breezes, or anevening nightcap, this inviting porch serves as a natural extension of the home’s living area.Fully Equipped Kitchen & Dining AreaAdjacent to the living room, the modern kitchen and dining area provide everything needed formeals at home. The dining table comfortably seats six, while the kitchen features a full-sizerefrigerator, four-burner electric cooktop, mounted microwave, full-size dishwasher, coffeemaker, ample cabinetry, cookware, and a nearby pantry for added storage. A convenient halfbathroom off the main living area enhances comfort and functionality.The Ideal Seaside, Florida GetawaySuite Magnolia I blends comfort, convenience, and classic Seaside charm in one of the mostwalkable locations along 30A. With private beach access, proximity to the West End FamilyPool, and the vibrant town center just steps away, this thoughtfully designed vacation rental isthe perfect home base for beach days, pool afternoons, and evenings exploring Seaside,Florida.* 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break, and Fall; 5-night minimum Summer; 2-night minimumWinter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.FEATURES● 352 yards or a 5 minute walk to private Seaside beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion● Four minute walk to West Side Family Pool● Two queen bedrooms with ensuite baths● Walkable to shops, dining, and Seaside town center● Screened porch with outdoor dining and rocking chairs● Outdoor charcoal gril● Access to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply) and a fitness center.● Welcome tote with 2 beach towels, a bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes forpickup at Seaside Transit Authority● Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided● 2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car, and for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.● No pets allowed
